jobs.occupation: ICT Talents - ERP Consultant (Oracle Fusion Cloud)
jobs.description:
For an international trading and distribution organisation, we are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Consultant to technically optimise the existing ERP environment and improve the efficiency of Finance and Operations.

Since the migration to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, many processes are still handled manually, with a lack of reporting and visibility. Your mission? To implement concrete improvements, reduce repetitive tasks and provide the business with the insights and tools it needs.
Job description

As an ERP Consultant, you will work closely with the heads of Finance and Operations. You will analyse existing processes, identify quick wins and translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
Your responsibilities

• Reporting: Developing reports, dashboards, views and worklists, potentially in combination with Power BI.

• Automation: Implementing bulk uploads, streamlining transaction processing and reducing manual tasks.

• ERP optimisation: Analysing and improving existing processes within the ERP environment, with a focus on order-to-cash and procure-to-pay.

• Integrations: Optimising data flows and connections with external systems, such as EDI and Excel-based processes.

• Stakeholder management: Coordinating with Finance, Operations and the international IT team, while critically assessing and challenging potential solutions.

• Knowledge transfer: Documenting the implemented solutions to ensure the internal team can maintain them independently after the project.

We are looking for a technically strong, analytical and hands-on consultant who can quickly identify opportunities and deliver pragmatic solutions.

You have:

• Relevant experience with ERP implementations

• Experience with reporting, dashboards, views and worklists

• Good knowledge of Power BI and experience with EDI integrations

• Knowledge of bulk uploads, mass transactions and ERP process optimisation

• An understanding of order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes

• Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is a strong asset, but not an absolute requirement

• A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to work within existing system limitations

• Strong communication skills and a good command of English

• Knowledge of Dutch is not required, but is considered a strong asset

• Experience with Azure DevOps is a plus

Purpose and Mission
 

To ensure Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert are the solution of choice in offshore operations applications (Single Point Mooring & Lifting Solutions). Organize and manage all commercial activity related to offshore operations. Create opportunities and secure orders to ensure the business meets its commercial objectives in line with the profit plan and agreed objectives and strategies.
 

Key Activities and Responsibilities
 

1. Identify concrete market potential, emerging trends, and industry shifts, including targeted qualification of key (lead) accounts within defined Single Point Mooring (SPM) applications. 
2. Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships between the organization and (potential) customers. 
3. Maintain and build worldwide strong network with agents. 
4. Negotiate effectively within commercial proposals to finalize sales agreements, ensuring acceptable deliverables and realistic timelines while balancing strict customer requirements with mutual commercial interests. 
5. Increase annual revenue from existing accounts by offering new products and services, identifying market opportunities and developing these into commercial solutions, and continuously evaluating the existing product range in line with 
6. Contribute to gathering relevant market intelligence by analyzing competitor products and customer feedback, and proactively adjusting commercial approaches accordingly. 
7. Collaborate closely with internal departments/teams to ensure the highest product quality and performance in order to fully meet customer expectations. 
8. Initiate and personally follow up on new R&D projects based on market perspectives and customer requirements. 
9. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
10. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
11. Prepare segment reports on account progress in line with defined objectives and key KPIs, supporting future business cases and corporate investment decisions. 
12. Coordinate and resolve customer complaints or problem scenarios, either single- or multidisciplinary, related to sales proposals and sales orders. 
13. Ensure accurate (pre-)sales administration, including quotation management, technical support coordination, contract compliance, sales order booking, lead-time and deliverable tracking, communication with support departments, customer payment follow-up, and non-conformity processes. 
14. Maintain up-to-date theoretical and practical technical knowledge relevant to the segment. 
15. Achieve segment sales results by meeting budgeted revenue and sales targets. 
16. Position Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert at the center of the offshore lifting ecosystem, building positive relationships with lifting engineers, rigging specialists, operators, and other stakeholders to ensure our products are widely accepted and specified in tenders. 
17. Responsible for visual inspection of slings, ensuring accurate assessment, proper documentation, and compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Strong commercial acumen with a track record of positive results in previous sales, business development, or project 
management roles. 
• Experience in offshore lifting, mooring, heavy lifting, or similar industries is a strong advantage. 
• Ability to develop and manage multiple accounts, balancing long-term relationship building with short-term revenue generation. 
• Strong interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence and persuade stakeholders.

You are not looking for a typical nine-to-five and you see the advantages of working in shifts every now and again — handsome bonusses and lots of quality time on your hands while others are ‘insanely busy’. An example of our shift regime:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift from Monday to Friday.

Oversee contractor-led tool installations for the Málaga cleanroom (Fab 5) project, with a focus on safety and conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines. 

 

What you will doFor the Málaga Fab 5 project, tool installations will be performed by the contractor. imec’s role focuses on safety oversight and validating that the installations conform to imec’s required standards and guidelines. That’s where you come in. Onboarding and training will take place in Leuven, Belgium until mid-2028, after which the position location will transfer to Málaga, Spain.  
As Project Lead, your role combines contractor oversight, safety follow-up and installation conformity validation on behalf of imec. 
The contractor is responsible for installation execution and day-to-day coordination of the installation works. You will monitor progress, review safety and quality matters, and coordinate interfaces with imec stakeholders, keeping a clear distinction between contractor execution and imec oversight. 
Your focus is to validate conformity with imec’s installation standards, guidelines and safety requirements. You will review contractor deliverables and installation evidence, follow up deviations and corrective actions, and support installation acceptance by imec rather than directly managing execution. 
You will: 
 
 

• Oversee contractor-led installations and coordinate interfaces with imec 

• Review contractor schedules and monitor progress against agreed milestones 

• Flag scope deviations and their impact on timelines, budgets and priorities 

• Validate installation conformity with imec’s standards and guidelines through reviews, inspections and supporting records 

• Provide safety oversight and follow up contractor actions on safety and quality findings 

• Keep internal stakeholders and external partners informed 

• Escalate risks and non-conformities, track corrective actions and review evidence for installation acceptance 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electromechanical Engineering.  

• You have at least 5 years of relevant technical experience.  

• You have experience overseeing contractor-led technical projects and reviewing installations against defined standards and guidelines.  

• You communicate openly and proactively with both internal customers and external partners about the status of ongoing work, and you escalate issues promptly when needed.  

• You adapt easily to changes and time pressure and combine a practical mindset with a strong focus on safety, quality and conformity.  

• You are fluent in English and Spanish.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment.
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with business analysts and software developers for our equipment integration solution. You will be supported by dedicated test engineers. 

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates. 

• You perform the crucial task of analyzing how our equipment integration software platform can implement business requirements. The specifications to be passed on to internal and more often external developers can range from straightforward configuration to additional logic to be defined. 

• Some business requirements will result in equipment integration being dependent on related configuration or even features to be implemented in adjacent applications, especially the MES. You thus will gain sufficient knowledge about adjacent CIM applications to effectively collaborate with their business analysts and functional analysts. 

• You have an active role in test preparation and debugging. You will be supported by our PMO team during all phases of the software lifecycle. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience. 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials. 

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab. 

• You have participated in a CIM project, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS. 

• You have strong analytical skills and are solution oriented. You can challenge assumptions and question approaches. 

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are dependable. 

• You feel comfortable in a complex environment. 

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities in an exciting environment. 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with equipment engineers and software developers.  

• You will receive industry specific training and can rely on experienced teammates.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial task will be the verification of equipment to host communication as specified during purchasing. Semiconductor equipment communication follows a comprehensive set of standards. However, these standards allow for differences in implementation and scope definition which often cause complications with equipment integration.  

• Once more experienced, you will play a decisive role in exploring equipment behavior at the communication interfaces under different operational scenarios.  

• Your test results are not just necessary for bug fixing. They are crucial input for equipment integration developers in the first place.  

• You will contribute to improving our test methodology, utilizing dedicated test software as well as equipment simulators. 

Who you are
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development and testing, specifically related to hardware automation.
